query: Bonn Germany Uber taxi fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Base fare (starting price) of a taxi in Bonn is 3.5 EUR. Each km is priced at 1.9 EUR (taxi-bonn-de.taxigator.net: 'Taxi rates start @ 1.30 EUR per km for Uber, local taxis'). Cab fares in Germany are set officially by cities/districts per official tariff ordinance; Uber pricing may differ from standard taxi rates with dynamic surge pricing during peak hours.
